subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository trust and land these 13 exact upstream Action revisions on the final rebased head, including the Codex Action update used by secret-bearing agent workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent, but it changes executable supply-chain code across credentialed and security-critical automation; repository policy requires owner judgment and direct Codex contract inspection that automation cannot safely substitute.

options.title: Approve after final-head validation
options.body: Rebase, finish the affected workflow checks, directly inspect the Codex contract, and approve the exact immutable revisions if all behavior remains compatible.

options.title: Split the Codex update
options.body: Land the routine Action refreshes separately and hold openai/codex-action until its direct source and live workflow behavior receive focused review.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place if the combined upstream review cost is not justified for this release train.

recommendation.title: Approve after final-head validation
recommendation.body: Rebase, finish the affected workflow checks, directly inspect the Codex contract, and approve the exact immutable revisions if all behavior remains compatible.
